evals.prompt: Make me a Rust CLI called logtail with a reusable library crate behind it.
evals.expected_output: Runs bootstrap with the crate profile, role both, then the full gate, and reports the result line.
assertions: Uses --profile crate (or the default) with --role both
Runs python3 tools/check.py in the generated project
Reports the 'All configured checks passed.' line or the failure

evals.prompt: I need firmware for an STM32F411 that reuses our parsing code.
evals.expected_output: Generates the embedded profile, retargets to thumbv7em-none-eabihf in rust-toolchain.toml, .cargo/config.toml, and CI, asks for or cites the memory map, and runs the gate without claiming hardware execution.
assertions: Changes the target in all three of rust-toolchain.toml, .cargo/config.toml, and the workflow
Does not claim the firmware ran on hardware

evals.prompt: Create a Tauri desktop app for note taking. Use npm for the frontend.
evals.expected_output: Explains that the tauri profile is Bun-only, proceeds with Bun unless the user objects, generates with --profile tauri, and runs the gate.
assertions: States the profile uses Bun instead of npm
Does not run npm or npx

evals.prompt: In this generated Tauri app, clippy fails after I added tauri-plugin-dialog. Just allow the lint.
evals.expected_output: Does not add allow attributes or lower lints; inspects the diagnostic, fixes at the cause or uses a scoped expect with a reason, or reports that the policy table needs an authorized change.
assertions: Adds no #[allow] and no lint level change in Cargo.toml
Runs python3 tools/check.py after the fix

evals.prompt: Add a wasm export that returns the CRC of a fixed buffer.
evals.expected_output: Puts the CRC logic and its test in the portable library and adds a private const extern C export with SAFETY comment and scoped expect(unsafe_code).
assertions: Logic and test live in the portable library, test in <module>/tests.rs
Export is not pub and carries #[unsafe(no_mangle)] with a SAFETY comment

evals.prompt: Why is my Rust iterator chain slow? Profile it.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger; this is optimization work.
